ABOUT K CHARLES HAULAGE
Trusted UK Haulage Company for Domestic & European Transport
Built on a family-run foundation, we understand the importance of reliability, clear communication, and competitive pricing.
Our goal is simple, to keep your business moving with dependable transport solutions you can trust. With years of industry experience, we work closely with every client to understand their requirements and provide a flexible, personalised service.
From the moment we collect your goods to the final delivery, our experienced drivers and specialised fleet manage the entire journey. Our streamlined logistics systems allow us to plan routes efficiently, monitor shipments, and maintain full accountability throughout the process.
The Right Vehicle for Every Transport Requirement
A modern, versatile fleet for business, trade and individual haulage across the UK and Europe.

Comprehensive Haulage & Transport Services
Reliable and flexible transport solutions across the UK and Europe, tailored to your requirements.
Specialist & Time-Critical Deliveries
To support construction firms, engineering companies, and high-value manufacturers, specialist and time-critical delivery services manage oversized, heavy, or sensitive loads using vehicle-specific planning, secured loading, and tightly coordinated delivery schedules.
For businesses facing urgent stock movements, production delays, or critical customer deadlines, same-day transport provides immediate vehicle allocation, rapid collection, and direct delivery within the UK.
Temperature-Controlled / Refrigerated Haulage
Through temperature-controlled haulage, we support food producers, beverage suppliers, pharmaceutical companies, and cold-chain distributors that require chilled or frozen transport with consistent temperature control throughout the journey.
Part Load (LTL) Haulage
Our part-load haulage service suits small to medium-sized businesses and growing operations that need cost-efficient transport for lower-volume shipments, enabling goods to move on scheduled routes while maintaining load separation, stability, and delivery reliability.
Full Truckload (FTL) Haulage
We provide full truckload haulage for manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers moving high-volume consignments, contract freight, or time-critical goods that require exclusive vehicle use, direct routing, and minimal handling from collection to delivery.
We offer international full truckload haulage for manufacturers, exporters, and large-volume shippers that require exclusive vehicle use for cross-border movements, supporting direct routing, reduced handling, and controlled transit times between the UK and European destinations.
Our international part-load haulage service helps businesses shipping lower-volume goods into Europe. This haulage service enables your consignments to move cost-effectively on shared routes while maintaining structured consolidation, cargo separation, and planned delivery schedules.
Temperature-Controlled European Haulage
Through temperature-controlled European haulage, chilled and frozen goods are transported in refrigerated vehicles under monitored conditions, supporting food, beverage, and pharmaceutical operators that require stable temperatures across international transit.
Time-Sensitive International Deliveries
For businesses working to fixed deadlines, production schedules, or contractual delivery windows, time-sensitive international deliveries provide planned cross-border transport with controlled routing and defined delivery timeframes to support continuity across European supply chains.
Businesses choose to partner with us because we combine direct fleet control with fully compliant operations and dependable capacity across the UK and Europe. Every delivery is managed through in-house planning, advanced route optimisation, and complete ownership of all administrative processes. We carefully match each shipment with the most suitable vehicle, assign experienced drivers, and accommodate any bespoke requirements to ensure your delivery runs smoothly. Our approach ensures clear accountability, safeguards goods in transit, and delivers consistent performance aligned with the highest safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
Modern, well-maintained fleet ensuring reliability, efficiency, and minimal downtime
Highly experienced, fully compliant drivers delivering professionalism and peace of mind on every journey
Comprehensive UK & European coverage with consistent, dependable capacity
RHA & BIFA accredited, demonstrating trusted industry standards and compliance
Flexible, scalable haulage solutions tailored to businesses of all sizes and requirements

How Our Haulage Process Works
From your first quote to confirmed delivery, we keep every movement planned, visible and reliable.
Request a quote
To begin, we need to gather detailed information regarding your goods, including the weight size, collection point and destination. This will allow us to provide you with the most accurate quote by recommending you with the right vehicle and preparing a feasible plan for the transportation.

Transport planning & scheduling
Once the details are confirmed, we plan the movement by allocating the appropriate vehicle and compliant driver and confirming routes and delivery windows. Where applicable, we also account for border requirements, handling instructions, and temperature controls to keep the load on schedule.
Optimal vehicle and route allocation.

Collection & secure delivery
At the point of collection, we load and secure goods using defined safety, restraint, and load-control procedures. We ensure the right transport conditions are used to protect your cargo and meet agreed delivery commitments under controlled conditions.
Goods loaded and secured safely.

Cargo integrity and compliance.

Throughout the journey, we provide clear transport updates to maintain visibility during transit. After delivery, we issue a confirmation to close the movement with full traceability and operational accountability.

INDUSTRIES WE SUPPORT
Haulage Services For A Range Of Industries
Reliable, flexible and industry-focused transport solutions across the UK and Europe.
Manufacturing & Distribution
We support manufacturing and distribution operations by using curtain-sided, rigid, and full-truckload vehicles to move raw materials, components, and finished goods between production sites, warehouses, and distribution centres.
Retail & E-commerce
Our haulage services for retail and e-commerce use rigid trucks and part-load vehicles to manage store replenishment, fulfilment movements, and regional distribution. Through scheduled routes, flexible vehicle allocation, and consistent handling, we help maintain stock availability, delivery accuracy, and service continuity.
Food & Beverage
Through temperature-controlled haulage, food and beverage businesses use refrigerated vehicles with monitored environments to transport chilled and frozen goods under defined temperature ranges. This approach protects product integrity and supports cold-chain requirements.
Construction & Heavy Goods
For construction and engineering projects, specialist haulage uses flatbed and low-loader vehicles to transport building materials, machinery, and oversized equipment. We account for weight, dimensions, and site access during vehicle selection, load securing, and route planning.
To support pharmaceutical companies and time-critical operations, these services use temperature-controlled, dedicated vehicles to meet strict delivery windows and handling requirements. Planning focuses on condition control, schedule accuracy, and secure movement.

Frequently Asked Questions
We offer a range of logistics and haulage services, across the United Kingdom and Europe. Our extensive fleet allows us to offer you with haulage solutions that meet all of your needs for goods transportation, ranging from partial loads, to specialised, temperature-controlled, long-haul deliveries.
How will you price my haulage quote?
To provide you with the most accurate quotation, at the best available price, we will need to gather key information regarding your load – including weight, size, destination and other special requirements. Then, once we settle on adequate vehicles and optimise routes, we will estimate your price. If you received a quote from another haulage company, we will be eager to investigate it and offer you a price match.
What type of goods is suitable for haulage?
Construction and industrial materials, food and agriculture, specialised loads (including hazardous materials), medical and pharmaceutical, as well as commercial consumer goods – we will suit a vehicle ideal for the items that require transporting.
Will I Receive Updates During Transport?
You should choose haulage when goods exceed standard parcel limits or require planned transport, vehicle capacity, and controlled handling rather than door-to-door small-item delivery. Haulage suits palletised freight, full or part loads, oversized or heavy items, temperature-controlled goods, multi-drop routes, and time-critical consignments that need scheduled collection and delivery, while courier services are more suitable for small, lightweight parcels, documents, or low-volume items that can move through standard door-to-door networks without special handling or vehicle allocation.
How Are Goods Protected During Transport?
Goods are protected during haulage through structured planning, vehicle suitability checks, and defined load-security procedures applied from collection to delivery. Protection measures include appropriate vehicle selection, professional loading and restraint methods, temperature monitoring where required, compliant driving practices, and insurance cover, ensuring cargo integrity, condition control, and risk reduction throughout the transport journey.
What Is the Difference Between Dedicated and Shared Haulage?
Dedicated haulage is a transport service in which a vehicle is used exclusively for one customer’s load, with direct routing and fixed scheduling, whereas shared haulage combines compatible consignments from multiple customers to reduce costs. Shared haulage follows planned routes with controlled handling, making it suitable for lower-volume shipments that do not require exclusive vehicle use.
How Should Goods Be Prepared Before Collection?
Goods should be prepared by ensuring they are securely packaged, correctly palletised where applicable, and clearly labelled with delivery details before collection. Loads must be stable, accessible for the selected vehicle type, and ready at the agreed time to allow safe loading, efficient handling, and on-schedule transport.
Do You Operate Different Vehicle Types?
Yes, we operate our own curtain-sided, refrigerated, rigid, van, flatbed, and low-loader vehicles to ensure full control over capacity, handling, and scheduling for each transport movement. Using an in-house fleet allows us to match vehicle specification to load size, weight, temperature requirements, and route conditions while maintaining consistent service standards across UK and European haulage operations.
Is There a Difference Between an HGV and a Haulage Vehicle?
An HGV (Heavy Goods Vehicle) is a legal vehicle classification for trucks with a gross weight over 3,500 kg (3.5 tonnes) and specific licensing and compliance requirements, whereas a haulage vehicle is a broader operational term that includes any vehicle used to transport commercial freight, such as HGVs, rigid trucks, vans, refrigerated units, flatbeds, and low-loaders, depending on load type and delivery needs.
Can a Single Vehicle Handle Multiple Delivery Points?
Yes, a single haulage vehicle can manage multi-drop delivery when the load plan, route sequence, and delivery timings support efficient distribution. Multi-drop delivery is commonly used for part load and distribution routes, where consignments are securely separated, drops are sequenced in advance, and vehicle capacity, access conditions, and delivery windows are planned to maintain schedule accuracy and cargo integrity across all delivery points.

Who We Are
Our team combines hands-on industry experience with hands-on customer service at every stage of your delivery journey. We serve clients throughout the UK and across key European markets, managing everything from local freight to cross-border transport.
We began with a simple goal, to provide logistics services that businesses could rely on, no excuses, no uncertainty. Starting as a small operation, we steadily expanded our fleet and capability, building a reputation for flexibility and responsiveness. Today, we’re proud to support companies across industries, from manufacturing and retail to specialised freight sectors that require precise handling.

From standard freight to urgent deliveries, our domestic transport solutions are efficient, flexible, and tailored to meet your logistics needs.
Whether you’re moving palletised goods, full loads, or specialised freight, we ensure your cargo is transported safely and delivered on time across the UK.
Our UK Haulage Service
Here’s what our service includes:
Modern Fleet of Vehicles
Our fleet consists of modern, well-maintained vehicles designed to handle a wide range of cargo types, from palletised goods and full truckloads to specialised freight. Each vehicle is regularly inspected and maintained to ensure reliability and safety, so your shipments are transported efficiently without risk of delays or damage. With the right vehicle for every load, we can accommodate different sizes, weights, and handling requirements.
Flexible Scheduling & On-Time Deliveries
We understand that timing is crucial for your business operations. That’s why we offer flexible collection and delivery schedules to suit your needs. Whether you require standard deliveries, urgent same-day transport, or timed drop-offs, our team plans routes and schedules to ensure your cargo arrives on time, helping you maintain a smooth and dependable supply chain.
Secure Handling & Load Protection
Your goods are in safe hands with our trained drivers and logistics staff. We use professional loading techniques, secure pallet placement, and appropriate restraint methods to minimise movement during transit. This careful handling reduces the risk of damage, ensuring your cargo reaches its destination in the same condition it was collected.
Our haulage services cover all regions across the United Kingdom, from major cities to more remote locations. No matter where your delivery needs to go, we ensure efficient routing, fast transit times, and reliable service, giving you confidence that your goods will arrive safely wherever they are needed.
